newsitem.title: INDIA: India SEBI to hold news conference on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: India SEBI to hold news conference on Thursday.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) will hold a news conference on Thursday after its board meeting to consider a takeover code and a stock lending scheme, SEBI's chairman said on Wednesday.
"Wait till tomorrow. There will be a press conference," D.R. Mehta told Reuters in New Delhi.
Earlier on Wednesday, Mehta met Finance Secretary Montek Singh Ahluwalia, the highest ranking civil servant in the Finance Ministry, to discuss the capital market, government officials said.
SEBI officials said the board meeting -- scheduled for Thursday morning in Bombay -- would also discuss an amendment in the country's share depository law and a report on short sales.

"I can't comment anything on that," Mehta responded when asked to comment on Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's statement earlier this week that the government was considering a package to boost the capital market this week.
Deve Gowda had said in Bombay on Monday that some decisions could be expected before he left on Friday for Davos, Switzerland to attend a meeting of the World Economic Forum.
